ModMetaData.name: HSK 农业大修
ModMetaData.author: GA-YUKI
ModMetaData.description:
本 mod 将 GA-YUKI 的两个农业类 mod 合并为独立整合包,并适配 HSK(Core SK)环境。原 mod 的名称、作者与简介全部保留。
收录内容: 1. Medieval Overhaul: Small Planting (GAYUKI.MO.SmallPlanting) — 为中世纪大修添加 1x1 与 1x2 的种植箱和爬藤架。 2. Medieval Steam Sun Lamp (GAYUKI.MedievalSteamSunLamp) — 为奇幻生物科技添加蒸汽太阳灯与小型蒸汽太阳灯。
原作者: GA-YUKI (Steam 创意工坊)。
HSK 本地适配说明: - 种植箱/爬藤架: 建造逻辑改用原版种植机机制(Building_PlantGrower),可种植任意地面作物;默认作物分别为水稻与啤酒花。 - 研究档位: 种植箱挂 农业I(SewageSludgeComposting);爬藤架挂 农业II(Cultivation_C1);太阳灯挂 照明I/II(Light_B1/Light_B2)。 - 萤石太阳灯: 仿 Core_SK 原生萤石灯(GlowstoneLamp)机制,萤石自发光、免电力免燃料,回归中世纪科技;小灯挂 照明I(Light_B1)、大灯挂 照明II(Light_B2),保留夜间自动关闭;并入 HSK"萤石灯具"二级菜单。 - 材料采用中世纪体系: 木/石框架 + 萤石 + 煤炭 + 泥土 + 玻璃,其余数值尽量沿用原作。
English: Merges two farming mods by GA-YUKI into one standalone package, adapted for Core SK (HSK): 1. Medieval Overhaul: Small Planting — Added 1x1 and 1x2 gardening box and post for the Medieval Overhaul. 2. Medieval Steam Sun Lamp — Added steam sun lamp and small steam sun lamp for the Fantasy Biotech.
Original mods by GA-YUKI (Steam Workshop). HSK adaptation: planter boxes/posts use the vanilla Building_PlantGrower mechanics (research: SewageSludgeComposting / Cultivation_C1); steam sun lamps are rebuilt as medieval glowstone sun lamps (self-glowing glowstone, no power or fuel needed; research: Light_B1 / Light_B2), keeping their night schedule and joining the HSK glowstone-lights submenu; materials use a medieval palette (glowstone, coal, dirt, glass, wood/stone frames).
